# 0445 — Both `WindowRegistrationRaceTests` fail in the Tart VM because they pass SwiftUI's auto-generated window identifier to `matching(identifier:)`, which XCUITest caps at 128 characters

| | |
|---|---|
| **Status** | resolved |
| **Branch** | `issue/0445` |
| **Module** | Testing |
| **Platform** | macOS |
| **First seen** | 2026-10-06 |
| **Closed** | 2026-10-09 |

## Description

In the full Tart-VM UI run on `issue/0444` @ `44addbb4` (run id `20261006-033829-79840`, results under `.claude/worktrees/agent-a23f5c9c7f4543e4c/build/ui-tests/20261006-033829-79840/`), 76 tests ran and exactly 2 failed, both in `BattyUITests/WindowRegistrationRaceTests.swift`:

- `testShiftCmdNThenImmediateCmdBCollapsesOnlyTheNewWindow` — `WindowRegistrationRaceTests.swift:75`
- `testShiftCmdNThenImmediateCmdNAddsSessionToTheNewWindow` — `WindowRegistrationRaceTests.swift:117`

Both throw the same `NSInternalInconsistencyException` from inside XCUITest, before any behavioural assertion runs (`xcodebuild.log:2454`, `:2473`):

```
Invalid query - string identifier 'SwiftUI.PresentedWindowContent<BattyKit.WindowID, SwiftUI.ModifiedContent<Batty_Beta.ContentView, SwiftUI._BackgroundModifier<Batty_Beta.OpenWindowHookInstaller>>>-1-AppWindow-1' exceeds maximum length of 128 characters. You can work around this limitation by constructing a query with a custom NSPredicate that specifies the property (label, title, value, placeholderValue, or identifier) to match against. (NSInternalInconsistencyException)
```

This is the same defect #0418 hit in its VM run 5 (`20261006-003321-25688`) and fixed in its round 6 (`issues/0418.md`, "Fix, round 6"): the test captures a window's AX `identifier` with `app.windows.firstMatch.identifier`, then looks the window up with `app.windows.matching(identifier: …)`. Batty assigns no identifier of its own to content windows, so the captured string is SwiftUI's mangled type name for the window content, and XCUITest refuses string-identifier queries longer than 128 characters. `WindowRestorationTests.swift` (on `main`, lines 132-133) already uses the workaround the error message names — `app.windows.matching(NSPredicate(format: "identifier == %@", id)).firstMatch` — and its class doc comment (lines 48-56) records why. `WindowRegistrationRaceTests.swift` was written against the pre-round-6 pattern and never caught up.

The two tests are the ones #0437 added. They have never run past this line in a VM: `issues/0437.md` ("Gotchas", line 138) records that `WindowRegistrationRaceTests` was type-checked only and "has not run in the VM", and the only full run between then and now (`20261006-003524-26742`, on `main` @ `1752688f`) failed them earlier, at lines 57 and 113, in #0444's no-window cascade (`build/ui-tests/20261006-003524-26742/xcodebuild.log:12492`, `:12540`). Run `20261006-033829-79840` on the `issue/0444` branch is the first time an app launch for these tests opened a window, which is why the identifier-length failure only surfaced now.

### The identifier is still over the limit after #0444

#0444's branch makes `OpenWindowHookInstaller` non-`private` (`Batty/BattyApp.swift`, `-private struct OpenWindowHookInstaller` → `+struct OpenWindowHookInstaller`), which removes the `(unknown context at $addr)` segment from the mangled name. That shortens the identifier but does not bring it under 128:

| | Identifier | Length |
|---|---|---|
| Before #0444 (`main`, seen in #0418 run 5) | `SwiftUI.PresentedWindowContent<BattyKit.WindowID, SwiftUI.ModifiedContent<Batty_Beta.ContentView, SwiftUI._BackgroundModifier<Batty_Beta.(unknown context at $106644ca8).OpenWindowHookInstaller>>>-1-AppWindow-1` | 209 |
| After #0444 (`issue/0444` @ `44addbb4`, this run) | `SwiftUI.PresentedWindowContent<BattyKit.WindowID, SwiftUI.ModifiedContent<Batty_Beta.ContentView, SwiftUI._BackgroundModifier<Batty_Beta.OpenWindowHookInstaller>>>-1-AppWindow-1` | 177 |

So the fix is not made moot by #0444 landing, and a predicate match is still required whichever way the identifier is spelled.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Commit on a branch that includes #0444's fix (otherwise the launch never opens a window and the tests fail earlier, at `:57`/`:113`).
2. `./build.sh ui BattyUITests/WindowRegistrationRaceTests` (Tart VM only — never on the host, per `AGENTS.md` "UI test automation").

## Expected behavior

Both tests reach their behavioural assertions and pass: Shift-Cmd-N then immediate Cmd-B collapses only the new window's Sidebar, and Shift-Cmd-N then immediate Cmd-N adds a Session to the new window.

## Actual behavior

Both tests abort with the `NSInternalInconsistencyException` above at the first `app.windows.matching(identifier:)` call — `:75` in the Cmd-B test and `:117` in the Cmd-N test — after 4.2 s and 3.2 s respectively. The suite reports `Executed 2 tests, with 2 failures`; the run as a whole is `Executed 76 tests, with 2 failures`.

## Notes

- **Fix:** replace the four `app.windows.matching(identifier: …)` calls in `WindowRegistrationRaceTests.swift` (`:75`, `:76`, `:117`, `:127`) with the `NSPredicate(format: "identifier == %@", id)` equality match that `WindowRestorationTests.swift:132-133` uses. An equality predicate on `identifier` is string-valued on both sides and is not the `MATCHES`-against-a-non-string-AX-value SIGABRT case in `docs/ui-testing-vm.md` "Known limits" (#0417); `issues/0418.md` "Review round 3" already accepted this reasoning, and `sessionRowCount(in:)` in the same file already uses an `identifier BEGINSWITH` predicate without incident.
- **Shared helper:** this is now the second file hand-rolling the same predicate, and the class doc comment explaining why lives only in `WindowRestorationTests.swift`. `BattyUITests/Support/BattyUITestHarness.swift` has no window-lookup helper at all (its `sidebar(in:)` overload takes a window the caller already resolved, and its doc comment still tells callers to pass `app.windows.element(boundBy: N)`, the index-based lookup #0438 found unreliable). The implementer should add one helper there — e.g. `static func window(withIdentifier:in:) -> XCUIElement` returning the predicate `firstMatch` — move the 128-character explanation onto it, and have both test files call it, so neither file carries its own copy of the workaround. Keep the fix test-only; the product should not grow a window identifier just to satisfy a test.
- **Verification:** `./build.sh ui-typecheck` on the host (#0442) catches type errors, but only a VM run proves the query is accepted — #0418's round 5 edit type-checked and still threw at runtime. The acceptance criterion below requires a full run, not just the one class, because these tests only open a window at all once #0444 is in; the fix branch should be cut from a `main` that includes #0444, or the run will fail at `:57`/`:113` again for the unrelated reason.
- The earlier full run on 2026-09-24 (`20260923-191103-94702`, 73 tests) predates #0437, so these two tests do not appear in it; there is no prior passing record of them anywhere.

## Acceptance criteria

- `testShiftCmdNThenImmediateCmdBCollapsesOnlyTheNewWindow` and `testShiftCmdNThenImmediateCmdNAddsSessionToTheNewWindow` both pass in a full `./build.sh ui` run in the Tart VM, with the run id and result recorded in this issue.
- No `app.windows.matching(identifier:)` call remains in `BattyUITests/` that is fed a SwiftUI-generated window identifier.

## Relation

- Tests added by #0437 (never run in the VM there; see its Gotchas).
- Same root cause and same fix as #0418 round 6 (`WindowRestorationTests`).
- Surfaced by #0444's VM run `20261006-033829-79840`; blocked from surfacing earlier by #0444's no-window cascade.
- Window identity by AX `identifier` rather than `app.windows` index is per #0438.

## Fix

Test-only. `BattyUITestHarness.window(withIdentifier:in:)` matches a window with
`NSPredicate(format: "identifier == %@", id)` instead of `matching(identifier:)`, which XCUITest
caps at 128 characters (SwiftUI's content-window identifier is 177 in Beta). Both
`WindowRegistrationRaceTests` lookups and `WindowRestorationTests` (#0418's inline predicate) now
use it; the `sidebar(in window:)` doc no longer recommends `boundBy:`; `docs/ui-testing-vm.md`
Known limits records the limit. Commit `0f39a1f3`.

## Verification

- `./build.sh`, `./build.sh ui-typecheck` pass on the host.
- Full Tart VM run `20261009-150820-16116` on `0f39a1f3`: **76 executed, 0 failures** — both
  `WindowRegistrationRaceTests` pass. First fully green full UI suite since the VM runner landed.

## Review — approve

Opus reviewer approved `0f39a1f3` (conditional on the full VM run, satisfied above): both tests stay
identity-based and would fail on misrouted Cmd-B/Cmd-N; `WindowRestorationTests` builds the same
query; no captured window identifier is fed to `matching(identifier:)`. Nit: the 177-character
figure is the Beta length (Prod is ~172, still over the limit).
